notes.title: FINAL FANTASY IV PATCH UPDATE FOR PC!
notes.content:
FINAL FANTASY IV PATCH UPDATE FOR PC!

As the first game in the series to feature the innovative Active Time Battle system, FINAL FANTASY IV stands as an iconic milestone in FINAL FANTASY history. 

Lose yourself in this timeless tale of heroes, betrayal, love and redemption now optimized for PC with brand new updates from the new patch released today!

Items Updated:

 Completely new interface
 Gamepad compatibility has been optimized.
 Small adjustments to keyboard, mouse, and touch panel operations have also been made.
 Full-screen now available
 Full-screen display now available until 21:9.
 The follow language settings are available:
 Chinese (Simplified)
 Chinese (Traditional)
 Korean
 Thai
 Japanese
 Small bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY IV Patch 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here's the changelog for update 1.0.1

Achievements:
The last achievement now unlocks correctly each time.

Launcher:
Issue with the launcher localisation when Russian language is selected has been fixed.

Miscellaneous:
Map bug has been addressed during the course of Golbez's Flashback.


Thanks for playing!

Square Enix
